architectural_risks.description: Post-booking Social Group auto-detect/auto-create is async (via order enricher, Approach 2a in BE ADR). The Social Group is NOT guaranteed to be present on the first AOS load — it lands on a later refresh once the async job completes.
architectural_risks.mitigation: Client handles a 'not yet resolved' state and refreshes on the next order-status poll/push rather than assuming the group is always present immediately after booking.
architectural_risks.testability_note: Verify AOS loads correctly without Social Group data on first load, then verify group chat entry point appears after a subsequent refresh/poll. Test timing window between booking and async group creation.

architectural_risks.description: Existing Share Tray components (GroupShareTray.kt, InviteFriendsTrayController, GroupShareTraySnappableHost.kt) are likely to be deprecated for Social-Group flows. CP confirmed the entire invite/share tray — including 'Invite Friends' from MPS/Shared Cart — will be owned and rendered by their SDK. The existing Food tray code should be treated as a fallback only, pending CP's SDK integration contract.
architectural_risks.mitigation: SocialGroupUiModel approach treated as fallback design. BAU sharing (Copy Link, QR code, WhatsApp) survival in the new CP-owned tray is still open — see Engineering Open Questions.
